payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including data augmentation techniques and segmentation methods.

claims.text: Data augmentation methods, such as Back Translation and Mix-Source, are used to generate additional training data to alleviate data sparsity in NMT systems.
Segmenting words into sub-components using methods like VNBPE allows NMT to learn translations with considerably fewer data.
The mix-source method is considered useful in low-resourced settings to help alleviate the data sparsity problem.
